families.precursor_task: The billing service tracks payment reminders per account. Add a method RecordDunningNotice(accountID string) DunningLevel on the billing Service that advances and returns the account's dunning level, keeping the per-account levels in the service. The DunningLevel type and its levels (LevelNone, LevelFirst, LevelFinal, LevelSuspended with Next()) already exist in the billing package. Add a regression test covering level advancement for one account and isolation between accounts.
families.target_task: Operations wants to see the newest payment-reminder event for an account. Add an exported function LatestDunningEvent(trail *Trail, action string) *Event in the audit package that returns the most recent audit event with that action, or nil when none exists. Add a regression test pinning the latest-match rule when several matching events exist and nil when none do.
